name: Jellyfin Federation
overview: Allows jellyfin servers to federate with each other
description: This Jellyfin plugin allows multiple Jellyfin servers to federate, sharing media libraries in real-time without syncing or copying files. Media can be streamed from one server to another with live transcoding if necessary.

versions.changelog: Consolidated 0.0.136-0.0.158: security and access fixes (confused-deputy peer POSTs, signed download flag, item-scoped playback/image capabilities, no re-sharing of downloaded federated files, anonymous inventory hardening, HMAC expiry, bounded friend requests/icons), correctness fixes (mapping/cache-key stability, catalog pruning, pool icons, Downloads path, strm export safety, WAN cap on direct streams, live Kestrel port for stamped paths), Companion/Plex fixes, and settings-page fixes including Friends copy, pool refresh, and per-user BlockedItemIds round-trip.

Jellyfin 12 support: rebuilt for .NET 10 and Jellyfin 12 APIs. Settings, badges, peer catalog, artwork and streaming use supported native authentication with legacy auth disabled. Older Jellyfin 10.11 servers should keep 0.0.135.

Plex Companion now reports a Federation plugin version and can join pools. Inviting a Plex friend no longer fails as an unknown/old plugin; they Accept the pool invite in Companion. Direct Plex Relay friends still need Funnel so the invite can be delivered.
